title: The Crab Derby, 2020
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Thirty-sixth annual. The last flyer Wood letters. The girl, ten, draws it and letters it herself. He watches. He doesn't touch the pen.

panels.composition: Gully's. The girl, ten, drawing AND lettering. WOOD on the stool with his hands in his lap. GULLY. BARNABY II.

image.prompt: a ten-year-old girl drawing and lettering a crab flyer at a shop counter while a thin man sits on a stool with his hands deliberately in his lap, a man in an apron, a dog, clean ink

panels.composition: Her lettering: 36TH ANNUAL CRAB DERBY. Not his face. Hers. Rounder. Right.

image.prompt: close-up of a child's careful rounded hand-lettering above a well-drawn crab

balloons.text: It's yours. That's the whole thing. It's yours.
It's the only one I've got.

image.prompt: a small girl holding up a finished flyer to a thin man who answers her seriously

panels.composition: Twenty-three flyers. The girl pinning the twenty-third. Gully with his hand on Wood's shoulder for exactly one panel.

image.prompt: a row of twenty-three crab flyers on a shingle wall, a girl pinning the newest, a stocky man's hand resting on a thin man's shoulder for a moment, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust

notes: The last flyer. Hers. Gully's hand on his shoulder, one panel.
